reference: Aff3DFunc (MM'25) functional text enhancement, four semantic views
notes: 四个视角各 2 条；appearance 沿用 v1 池前 2 条，action/function/environment 按 affordance 语义新写。描述只讲区域的功能语义，不含实例掩码或测试答案。

action: a region you can swing or strike against something
a place where impact is delivered to a target
function: a head that delivers force on impact
a striking face that transfers momentum to the target
appearance: A face that can be struck to produce sound
A head or surface that can be hit with a hand or stick
environment: usable when repeated striking is needed
effective when there is room to swing

action: a region you can hold while transporting the object
a place where the hand keeps the object steady in motion
function: a zone that bears the load while the object is moved
a place that keeps the object balanced during transport
appearance: A handle that a hand can hold while moving the object
A strap or band that can be held or slung
environment: usable when the object must be taken elsewhere
effective when walking with the object in hand

action: a region you can rub against a surface to remove dirt
a place where the object is swept across a soiled area
function: a working face that lifts or loosens dirt on contact
an area that does the scrubbing or wiping work
appearance: A surface that can be wiped with a cloth or hand
A contact face that touches the surface being cleaned
environment: usable when a surface needs dirt removed
effective when combined with water or cleaner

action: a region you can place loose items into without them falling out
a space where contents can be dropped and left to settle
function: a space that keeps loose items gathered in one place
a volume that prevents contents from scattering
appearance: An inner cavity that can hold loose items without spilling
An upward-opening bowl or basin shaped surface
environment: usable when the object sits upright on a stable surface
effective when items need to be held during transport

action: a region you can draw across material to separate it
a place where the edge is dragged through the workpiece
function: an edge that concentrates force to sever material
a boundary that splits material along a line
appearance: A thin sharp edge that can slice through material
A blade edge that meets the material along a line
environment: usable when material needs separating into pieces
effective when the object is held steady against the material

action: a region where an item can be placed to be seen
a place you can arrange objects on for viewing
function: a surface that presents items at a visible angle
a zone that makes placed objects easy to look at
appearance: A front-facing surface that faces a viewer
A screen or panel area that shows visual content
environment: usable in a room where people pass by and look
suitable when objects should stay visible rather than stored

action: a region you can wrap your fingers around and squeeze to hold firmly
a place where the hand can close and apply opposing pressure
function: a place that lets the hand take control of the whole object
a contact zone that keeps the object from slipping out of the hand
appearance: A narrow part that a hand can close around with fingers and thumb
A protruding handle or bar that leaves clearance for a grip
environment: usable when the object is within arm's reach and unobstructed
reliable to grab when the object rests on a flat surface

action: a region a person can rest their body across horizontally
a place where the body can be lowered down onto
function: a surface that spreads body weight evenly to avoid pressure
a plane that keeps a lying person supported and level
appearance: A broad flat surface where an object can be placed down
A horizontal top plane that stays stable under a load
environment: usable when the person needs to rest for an extended time
suitable in a quiet indoor space meant for resting

action: a region you can push upward on to raise the object
a place where an upward force can be applied without slipping
function: a place that carries the weight of the whole object when raised
a load-bearing zone that transfers lifting force into the object
appearance: A handle or grip that supports pulling the object upward
A stable underside where a hand can support the weight from below
environment: usable when the object is heavy enough to need a firm hold
safe to lift from when there is clear space above

action: a region you can bring close to the ear to hear sound
a place where sound is emitted and can be received
function: a zone that outputs audible sound toward a listener
an area that couples sound from the device to the ear
appearance: An ear-facing part that sits close to the listener ear
A speaker opening where sound comes out
environment: usable in a quiet setting where the sound is audible
effective when the listener is close to the object

action: a region you can push or pull to shift the object's position
a place where force can start or guide motion
function: a zone that lets the object be repositioned without damage
a contact place that transfers pushing force into movement
appearance: A handle that lets the object be pushed or dragged across a surface
A base or wheel region that slides along the ground
environment: usable when the object needs relocating across a surface
effective when there is clear space in the direction of travel

action: a region you can pull or press to make an enclosure accessible
a place where force starts the movement of a lid or door
function: a place that releases the closure and exposes the interior
a trigger zone that separates two joined parts
appearance: A handle that can be pulled to swing a door or lid outward
An edge or lip where fingers can pry a cover apart
environment: usable when the container is closed and needs accessing
effective when one hand can steady the body while opening

action: a region you can strike, press or handle to use the object
a place where the user interacts during play
function: a zone that responds to interaction with sound or motion
an area that produces the intended play response
appearance: A part that is struck or manipulated during play
A surface that is touched or pressed to produce sound
environment: usable when the object is being used for recreation
effective in a setting meant for leisure activity

action: a region you can tilt so liquid or contents flow out
a place where the opening directs the stream outward
function: a spout that controls the direction and rate of flow
a mouth that lets contents leave the container cleanly
appearance: A spout or lip that directs liquid out in a controlled stream
An open mouth or rim from which contents can be tipped out
environment: usable when the container is tipped over a target
effective when the contents are liquid or granular

action: a region you can push down on with a finger
a place where a short press triggers a response
function: a zone that receives finger force and activates a control
an area that registers a deliberate press
appearance: A flat area that a finger can push down on
A raised button that depresses under finger force
environment: usable when the object is within fingertip reach
effective when a deliberate input is needed

action: a region you can grip and draw toward yourself
a place where a pulling force is applied to open or move
function: a handle that lets a pulling force move the whole object
a zone that transfers a tug into motion of the part
appearance: A handle that can be grasped and drawn toward the body
An edge or lip where fingers can hook and pull
environment: usable when the object or part must come toward the user
effective when there is clearance in the pulling direction

action: a region you can press against with the hand or body
a place where forward force is applied to slide something
function: a zone that takes compressive force and moves the object away
a contact area that transfers a shove into motion
appearance: A flat surface where a hand can press to move the object away
A protruding part that can be pushed with a finger
environment: usable when the object needs to slide rather than be lifted
effective when there is open space ahead of the object

action: a region a person can mount and stay on
a place where the body sits or stands during travel
function: a surface that supports a person while the object moves
a zone that keeps the rider stable in motion
appearance: A surface a person can sit on while being carried
A foot support where a rider places their feet
environment: usable when the object is used for transport
effective on open ground with room to move

action: a region a person can lower themselves onto and rest
a place where the body settles with weight on the pelvis
function: a surface that bears body weight from above while seated
a support plane that keeps a seated person stable
appearance: A flat horizontal surface at seating height that supports a person
A broad stable platform that can bear body weight from above
environment: usable when the surface is at seating height and level
suitable wherever a person needs to stay seated for a while

action: a region you can bring close to the mouth to project voice
a place where sound from the mouth enters the device
function: a mouthpiece that channels voice into the object
an area that picks up speech for transmission or amplification
appearance: An opening that faces the speaker mouth
A mouthpiece region that picks up the voice
environment: usable when the speaker is near the object
effective when the voice needs carrying further

action: a region you can drive point-first into a surface
a place where the tip penetrates material
function: a tip that concentrates force into a small entry point
a point that pierces rather than slices
appearance: A sharp point that can penetrate a surface
A tapered tip that concentrates force into a small area
environment: usable when a small puncture is needed
effective when force is applied along the shaft

action: a region you can set an object down onto
a place where weight can be placed from above
function: a surface that holds another object steady under gravity
a bearing plane that keeps placed items from tipping
appearance: A load-bearing surface that holds another object from below
A rigid base region that keeps an item steady
environment: usable when the object placed on it needs to stay put
effective on a level surface clear of clutter

action: a region that goes against the body when worn
a place that rests on the head, face or hands during use
function: a contact zone that keeps the object attached to the body
an area that fits the body so the object stays in place
appearance: A part that makes contact with the body when worn
An opening or band that fits around a head, wrist or torso
environment: usable when the object is carried on the person
suitable for extended contact with skin or clothing

action: a region you can curl the whole hand around and clamp
a place where all fingers can close over at once
function: a place that gives a power grip for holding heavy things
a zone that lets the hand lock the object against the palm
appearance: A cylindrical body that a whole hand can wrap around
A rounded neck narrow enough for fingers to encircle
environment: usable when a firm grip is needed rather than a delicate one
reliable when the object must not rotate in the hand
